authorization: User requested compact shared verbal plurals, consistent later-unit paradigm styling, and repository housekeeping.
scope: All eighteen learner and answer-key masters and their complete exports; presentation only, with source-link maintenance.
table_rules: Use person and number as the row axis for finite verb paradigms. Combine three plural rows as 1–3 pl. only when every displayed form, alternative and scope agrees.
Retain separate imperative persons, impersonal bounds, pronouns, complete clauses and numbered response grids.
When both tenses are already taught together, use Present and Preterite columns. Preserve separate tense sections and their teaching order.
Use Nominative, Genitive, Dative, Accusative rows and Singular/Plural columns in nominal paradigms. Preserve singular-only, plural-only and reference-only limits.
Use Masculine, Neuter, Feminine order, moving every form with its label. Wide adjective matrices print in separate singular and plural panels.
Use the later-unit Cambria 10.5/13.2 point table style, ragged-right cells, bold headers, booktabs horizontal rules and no vertical rules.
Retain all forms, variants, length marks, reconstruction marks, support and source notes. Update only prose that describes changed table orientation or labels.
invariants: Canonical logical paradigm coordinates, form IDs, grammatical analyses, senses, milestones, task IDs, original prompts and answer meanings are preserved.
Record explicit reversible mappings from every original form cell to its displayed counterpart. Printed cell counts and logical paradigm counts are distinct.
Keep existing non-table TeX and manual page-layout repairs except bounded repairs required by changed pagination.
Preserve necessary primary evidence at current source paths and verify all updated links.
Earlier review identities certify their earlier checkpoints. New page inspections must identify the actual revised PDFs.
acceptance: Independent review of lossless table mappings and all protected exceptions.
No unapproved lexical, grammatical, task or key change; all 644 Cook items remain assigned.
Complete Markdown/TeX/PDF content verification and clean build diagnostics.
Actual inspection of every newly rendered page, with bounded reuse only for verified identical previously inspected page images.
Current indexes, page counts, reproduction instructions and source links agree with the revised artifacts.
Beads exported and a recoverable local Git revision saved.
